subject.title: fix(cli): prevent update dry runs from mutating state

question: Should OpenClaw formally preserve only `openclaw update --dry-run` as the supported preview form and reject dry-run repair, finalization, and wizard subcommands?
rationale: The repair removes real state mutations from previews, but it also changes behavior for existing command forms and the PR carries the protected `maintainer` label.

options.title: Confirm the narrow preview contract
options.body: Treat only the top-level update preview as supported, rebase the PR, and land after exact-head focused proof.

options.title: Preserve subcommand previews
options.body: Define and implement non-mutating preview behavior for repair, finalization, and wizard instead of rejecting those forms.

recommendation.title: Confirm the narrow preview contract
recommendation.body: Treat only the top-level update preview as supported, rebase the PR, and land after exact-head focused proof.
